cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

root_cause: No string-concatenated SQL command is present; values are bound through a prepared statement.
explanation: The unit is the safe counterpart for CWE-89 in the seed. Regex rules do not fire. The cited lines show a placeholder query rather than concatenation.
remediation: Keep using parameterized queries; do not concatenate identifiers or values into SQL.
